note: Curated job templates. A change to an image digest, command or default SKU changes what customers run under a name they trust, and is reviewed like a SKU change. Images are pinned by digest; the tag beside it is for the reader. See docs/spec/templates.md.

templates.title: Batch embeddings with vLLM
templates.description: Embeds an OpenAI batch file of /v1/embeddings requests with vLLM's batch runner and writes one result line per request. Default model Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (Apache-2.0), downloaded from Hugging Face at start.

inputs.description: Directory containing requests.jsonl: one OpenAI batch line per request with url /v1/embeddings

outputs.description: results.jsonl: one OpenAI batch result line per request, matched by custom_id

templates.title: Batch chat completions with your LoRA adapter
templates.description: Runs an OpenAI batch file of /v1/chat/completions requests through vLLM with a LoRA adapter applied (for example the adapter.tar.gz a finetune-lora job produced) and writes one result line per request, like batch-infer-vllm. Default base model Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (Apache-2.0); the adapter must have been trained on the same base.
command:
set -euo pipefail
for a in /mnt/adapter/*.tar.gz /mnt/adapter/*.tgz; do [ -f "$a" ] && tar -xzf "$a" -C /mnt/adapter; done
ADAPTER=$(dirname "$(find /mnt/adapter -name adapter_config.json | head -n 1)")
[ -n "$ADAPTER" ] && [ -f "$ADAPTER/adapter_config.json" ] || { echo 'adapter archive must contain adapter_config.json' >&2; exit 2; }
exec python infer_lora.py --model "$MODEL" ${MODEL_REVISION:+--revision "$MODEL_REVISION"} --lora "$ADAPTER" --lora-name "$LORA_NAME" -i /mnt/in/requests.jsonl -o /mnt/out/results.jsonl --max-model-len "$MAX_MODEL_LEN" --max-lora-rank "$MAX_LORA_RANK"

inputs.description: requests.jsonl: one OpenAI batch line per request with url /v1/chat/completions; the model field is ignored, the adapter applies to every line
adapter.tar.gz: a PEFT LoRA adapter directory (adapter_config.json, adapter_model.safetensors), as finetune-lora writes it

outputs.description: results.jsonl: one OpenAI batch result line per request, matched by custom_id, model = LORA_NAME

templates.title: LoRA fine-tune with evaluation
templates.description: The reference fine-tune: zero-shot and 3-shot baselines, a gate that stops if few-shot is already good enough, LoRA SFT with TRL and PEFT, and an eval with the adapter. Default base model Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (Apache-2.0). Input is one data.tar.gz from finetune/prepare_data.py --archive; the adapter comes back as adapter.tar.gz, which batch-infer-lora takes as its input.
command:
set -euo pipefail
# One archive in, unpacked beside itself: the template takes one file per input mount.
for a in /mnt/in/*.tar.gz /mnt/in/*.tgz; do [ -f "$a" ] && tar -xzf "$a" -C /mnt/in; done
[ -f /mnt/in/train.jsonl ] && [ -f /mnt/in/val.jsonl ] && [ -f /mnt/in/test.jsonl ] || { echo 'input archive must contain train.jsonl, val.jsonl and test.jsonl' >&2; exit 2; }
[ -z "${SCHEMA}" ] && [ -f /mnt/in/schema.json ] && SCHEMA=/mnt/in/schema.json
SCHEMA_ARG=""
[ -n "${SCHEMA}" ] && SCHEMA_ARG="--schema ${SCHEMA}"
python eval.py --model "$BASE_MODEL" --test /mnt/in/test.jsonl $SCHEMA_ARG --out /mnt/out/eval_zero_shot.json
python eval.py --model "$BASE_MODEL" --test /mnt/in/test.jsonl --train /mnt/in/train.jsonl --few-shot 3 $SCHEMA_ARG --out /mnt/out/eval_few_shot.json
python - "$FEW_SHOT_GATE" <<'PY'
import json, sys
s = json.load(open("/mnt/out/eval_few_shot.json"))["summary"]
rate = s["schema_valid_rate"] if s["schema_valid_rate"] is not None else s["json_parseable_rate"]
if rate >= float(sys.argv[1]):
    open("/mnt/out/RESULT", "w").write("task_not_worth_finetuning\n")
    print(f"few-shot already at {rate:.3f}; stopping before training")
PY
if [ -f /mnt/out/RESULT ]; then exit 0; fi
python train.py --model "$BASE_MODEL" --train /mnt/in/train.jsonl --val /mnt/in/val.jsonl --out /mnt/out/adapter --timestamps /mnt/out/timestamps.json
python eval.py --model "$BASE_MODEL" --lora /mnt/out/adapter --test /mnt/in/test.jsonl $SCHEMA_ARG --out /mnt/out/eval_lora.json
# The adapter as one file, for batch-infer-lora's /mnt/adapter input.
tar -czf /mnt/out/adapter.tar.gz -C /mnt/out adapter
echo completed > /mnt/out/RESULT

inputs.description: data.tar.gz from finetune/prepare_data.py --archive: train.jsonl, val.jsonl, test.jsonl, and optionally schema.json (used when SCHEMA is empty). One file; the command unpacks it.

outputs.description: eval_zero_shot.json, eval_few_shot.json, eval_lora.json, adapter/ and adapter.tar.gz, timestamps.json and RESULT (completed or task_not_worth_finetuning)
